sentences.text:
5. The first information report of the matter was lodged on 29.06.2024 by Satyanarayan @
Shivchand against the applicant and Indu Sharma alleging therein that his daughter aged about 13 years is studying in Class-VIII.

Her aunt (Chachi) Indu Sharma took her on 23.06.2024 for attending a birthday party and took her to Issari Salempur, District Ballia wherein she took money from the applicant and handed over his daughter.
The applicant then committed rape upon her and threatened her that if she tells to any one he would murder her.
6. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.

It is submitted that Indu Sharma, the co-accused in the matter has been granted bail by co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 30.05.2025 in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 36436 of 2024.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 36436 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The copy of the order has been produced before this Court which is taken on record.
It is submitted that charge sheet in the matter has been submitted on 26.07.2024.
It is further submitted that the applicant has not committed any offence.

It is further argued that the co-accused Indu Sharma is an Aasha Worker and the father of the applicant is also an employee in the health department, who used to get the co-accused dropped to her house through the applicant.
The applicant had normal acquaintance with the family of co-accused.
It is submitted that the applicant was involved in one other case in which he has been acquitted as stated in paragraph 25 of the affidavit.

The applicant is in jail since 30.06.2024.
7.

Per contra, learned counsel for the State vehemently opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the applicant is named in the F.I.R. and also in the statement of the victim recorded during investigation wherein she states that the applicant committing sexual assault on her.
It is further submitted that the victim is a minor girl aged about 13 years.

It is submitted that insofar as the co-accused Indu Sharma is concerned, she was a lady and related to the first informant which is mentioned in the order of granting bail to her and as such the case of the applicant is distinguishable to that of co-accused.
It is submitted that there is no reason for false implication of the applicant.
8. After hearing the learned counsels for the parties and perusing the records, it is evident that the applicant is named in the F.I.R. and in the statements of the victim during investigation.
The victim is minor girl aged about 13 years.
The applicant is alleged to have committed rape upon her.
The applicant further is alleged to have given money to the co-accused Indu Sharma and then sexually assaulted the victim.
No ground for bail is made out.
9. Accordingly the present bail application is rejected.

Order Date :- 10.7.2025 Manoj (Samit Gopal,J.)
